scope: Pure CPU actual host terrain,100 preset pairs, geometric trajectory/heading bounds and OrbitControls-compatible pose checks. No browser/visual/FPS proof.

checks.name: opposite presets avoid old linear target-eye singularity
valid endpoints are exact and completion clamps without overshoot
start and finish have vanishing positional and camera angular velocity
all100 host preset pairs have exact legal endpoints and finite separated look
all100 actual preset paths satisfy requested heading and planned speed bounds
curve retains radial envelope rather than crossing through island centre
yaw wrap179to-179takes2degrees rather than358
near-antipodal tie chooses same island side under submillimetre perturbations
no roll: camera right remains horizontal across all turning paths
look distance stays positive in logarithmic near-far interpolation
in-place look change leaves eye stationary when terrain safe
an interrupted transition starts from the currently displayed pose without teleport
reduced motion uses one final safe cut instead of fast180degree flight
unchanged preset is an immediate no-motion result
terrain hump raises planned route before exact floor guard
unsafe endpoint floor is explicitly adjusted and reported
zenith and nadir targets respect OrbitControls pole margins explicitly
sampling order and frame schedule do not alter pose
input mutation and returned arrays cannot mutate frozen path
invalid poses and configuration are rejected before path construction
module has no wallclock renderer randomness or scene mutation dependencies

limits: No full tree/prop collision solver. Terrain survey plus point guard handles ground.
Interrupting an in-progress flight preserves pose and heading (C0), but starts a new ease at rest rather than matching prior velocity (not C1).
World-up no-roll camera requires host OrbitControls pitch limits and no other simultaneous pose writer.
No actual native camera switching, performance or subjective nausea acceptance is inferred from these CPU checks.
